sources.title: Anthropic raises $65B in Series H funding at $965B post-money valuation

event.title: Anthropic Series H
event.summary: Anthropic raised a Series H equity round led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital. The round includes investments that hyperscalers had committed earlier, including Amazon's.

participants.note: Named as Fidelity Management & Research Company
Named as T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc. and T. Rowe Price Investment Management, Inc.

amounts.label: Series H equity
amounts.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.

amounts.label: Post-money valuation
amounts.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.

amounts.label: Previously committed hyperscaler investments (included)
amounts.quote: It also includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon.

amounts.label: Amazon (included)
amounts.quote: It also includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon.

facts.text: AMP PBC, Baillie Gifford, Blackstone, Brookfield, D.E. facts.label: Strategic infrastructure partners
facts.text: Micron, Samsung and SK hynix joined the round as strategic infrastructure partners.
facts.quote: Joining them are strategic infrastructure partners — Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix — whose technologies play a critical role in the world's supply of memory, storage, and logic chips.

relations.note: Amazon's $5 billion investment of April 20, 2026 is part of this round.
